mechanism.base: Ore does not fall from the sky. It forms inside the mountain, where the ground is dense and damp and nothing hurries, and the old texts say the metal is fed there by darkness and by weight. Every blade began as a vein in the rock. The soil that held it gave it its patience, and when the edge is struck at last, the stone is still in it, doing the holding.
mechanism.friction_turn: With too much Earth, the ore stays in the ground: fed so long that no edge is ever struck from it. Getting ready becomes a place to live. Make one rough cut this week.

friction.clause: The ore stays in the ground: fed so long that no edge is ever struck from it.
friction.remedy: Make one rough cut this week.

function.definition_friction: Earth is your Mind, and as a friction, it is ground that keeps taking and gives no edge back. The hunger to understand makes every decision one more thing to learn first, and the need for shelter makes your quiet hours a place to hide. Wise, and still not started.
function.advise_friction: Understanding is the safest place you own, and safety is the cost. Cook the dish you only read about. Say the half-formed theory out loud to one friend. Seek Wood, the Action energy. Wood grows toward light, and it roots where it stands: a claim staked before the ground is known. Let it spend what Earth stores.

candidates.cta_verdict: Your mind learns by sitting with a thing until it settles, so the answer you trust most is usually the one you gave last.

mechanism.base: Metal is born of earth, the old texts say: it lies in the mountain, gathered in stone, grown by slow pressure and the moisture of deep ground. Nothing hurries it. The mountain holds the ore for ages before any edge is struck from it, and every blade remembers the patience of the rock that made it.
mechanism.friction_turn: Run heavy, the shelter closes over the blade: so much preparation that the edge never leaves the mine. Comfort begins to bury what it formed. Dig out and cut something real.

friction.clause: The shelter closes over the blade: so much preparation that the edge never leaves the mine.
friction.remedy: Dig out and cut something real.

function.definition_friction: Earth is your Mind, and as a friction, it is intake with no off switch. Study, comfort, preparation, shelter: everything that goes in counts as progress, so nothing ever has to come out. Learning becomes the most respectable way to stand still.
function.advise_friction: At some point more learning is just fear with a reading list. Trade study for evidence: for every hour that goes in, one small thing comes out where someone can see it. Give each research topic a decision date. Finish one old course before any new one gets your money.

$original.cta_verdict: Your mind takes things in slowly and keeps them forever, and your best judgments are the ones you let sit overnight.
